notes: Baseline is v11 with the existing joint utility and branch changes; after is v12 with constrained offense bounds.
Same current JavaScript is used for both binaries with fresh Node/Native processes; no exact cache used.
Ten repeats per version and per fixture, alternating before/after and after/before; no builds/tests overlapped timings.
Source input is the original user-reported Revenir reproduction. Only the second fixture applies the user-reported Etowal lock. No stat, gear, buff or requirement numbers were modified.
Both fixtures are feasible; all 40 results are exact with identical full bestBuild, raw options and score within each fixture.
Native PeakWorkingSet64 sampled at 50ms; Node memory excluded. Short locked runs are sensitive to memory sampling.
Sample P95 uses nearest rank of ten samples (maximum); these two variants do not certify all required inputs or application UI P95.
